meta.title: Hernán Vargas — Fullstack Engineer
meta.description: Fullstack engineer with an M.Sc. in Computer Engineering, based in Chile. Close to ten years of fullstack and research software development: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Java, Docker and Kubernetes.

summary: Fullstack engineer with an M.Sc. and close to ten years building research software and web systems end to end. I spent nearly six years at the Information Sciences Institute of the University of Southern California, as lead frontend developer on MINT and lead developer on both ends of DISK — platforms that let scientists compose models and automate their data analysis. I now design and build the data management system for the Centro de Estudios Mineralógicos, from the database schema through to the web portal and the desktop application that feeds it.

achievements: Designed and built CEM's data management system: business logic, user administration, internal messaging and interactive visualizations.
Designed the database schema and the API.
Developed the desktop application for file ingestion and server administration.
Developed the web portal for clients and internal staff.
Deployed on on-premise Windows servers.
